# LAMMPS input script for bulk aluminum relaxation

# Initialization
units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p

# Read structure
read_data /results/6_Nov_Optimised/claude_45/react/surface_energy/subtask_true/level_1/workflow/aluminum_surface_1_subtask_structure_retrieval_trial_0/structure.data

# Replicate 5x5x5
replicate 5 5 5

# Define potential
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/EAM/Al99.eam.alloy Al

# Compute total energy
compute pe all pe/atom
compute total_pe all reduce sum c_pe

# Thermo output
thermo 100
thermo_style custom step pe c_total_pe press vol

# Energy minimization using conjugate gradient
min_style cg
minimize 1e-10 1e-10 100000 100000

# Output final energy
variable final_energy equal pe
print "Final Energy: ${final_energy} eV"

# Write relaxed structure
write_data /results/6_Nov_Optimised/claude_45/react/surface_energy/subtask_true/level_1/workflow/aluminum_surface_1_subtask_bulk_energy_minimisation_trial_0/relaxed_structure.data

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import re

# Read the dump file
with open('relaxed_slab.dump', 'r') as f:
    lines = f.readlines()

# Parse the dump file
atoms = []
box_bounds = []
reading_atoms = false

for i, line in enumerate(lines):
    if 'NUMBER OF ATOMS' in line:
        natoms = int(lines[i+1].strip())
    elif 'BOX BOUNDS' in line:
        # Read box bounds (next 3 lines)
        for j in range(1, 4):
            bounds = lines[i+j].strip().split()
            box_bounds.append((float(bounds[0]), float(bounds[1])))
    elif 'ITEM: ATOMS' in line:
        reading_atoms = true
        continue
    elif reading_atoms:
        parts = line.strip().split()
        if len(parts) >= 5:
            atom_id = int(parts[0])
            atom_type = int(parts[1])
            x = float(parts[2])
            y = float(parts[3])
            z = float(parts[4])
            atoms.append((atom_id, atom_type, x, y, z))

# Sort atoms by ID
atoms.sort(key=lambda x: x[0])

# Write LAMMPS data file
with open('relaxed_slab.data', 'w') as f:
    f.write('Relaxed aluminum slab structure\n\n')
    f.write(f'{natoms}  atoms\n\n')
    f.write('1  atom types\n\n')
    f.write(f'{box_bounds[0][0]:.6f} {box_bounds[0][1]:.6f}  xlo xhi\n')
    f.write(f'{box_bounds[1][0]:.6f} {box_bounds[1][1]:.6f}  ylo yhi\n')
    f.write(f'{box_bounds[2][0]:.6f} {box_bounds[2][1]:.6f}  zlo zhi\n')
    f.write('0.0 0.0 0.0 xy xz yz\n\n')
    f.write('Masses\n\n')
    f.write('1  26.981539\n\n')
    f.write('Atoms\n\n')
    
    for atom in atoms:
        atom_id, atom_type, x, y, z = atom
        f.write(f'{atom_id}  {atom_type} {x:.6f} {y:.6f} {z:.6f}\n')

print('Conversion complete: relaxed_slab.data created')
print(f'Total atoms: {natoms}')
print(f'Box dimensions:')
print(f'  x: {box_bounds[0][0]:.6f} to {box_bounds[0][1]:.6f}')
print(f'  y: {box_bounds[1][0]:.6f} to {box_bounds[1][1]:.6f}')
print(f'  z: {box_bounds[2][0]:.6f} to {box_bounds[2][1]:.6f}')
